description: SPEC §8 'Stop-reason recovery'. Style-neutral scripted responses; every port replays each case in BOTH styles (openai, anthropic) and in BOTH loops (run, stream). Mapping: stop 'end' => openai finish_reason 'stop' / anthropic stop_reason 'end_turn'; 'truncated' => 'length' / 'max_tokens'; 'tool' => 'tool_calls' / 'tool_use'. A tool call's 'arguments' is the raw string: openai sends it verbatim as function.arguments; anthropic sends input = the parsed value when it parses to a JSON object, else (non-streaming) input = the raw string, (streaming) partial_json = the raw string. 'thinking' is reasoning text: anthropic sends a {type:'thinking', thinking, signature:'sig'} block before any text block; openai sends it as message.reasoning_content (streaming: delta.reasoning_content) — the client ignores it either way. The toolkit holds one native tool 'echo' (input schema: object, no required fields) that returns the text 'ok'. Expected: 'turns' = provider calls made; 'text' = RunResult.text (and done.result.text); 'recoveries' = the pinned user messages appended, in order, each being the LAST message of the next request; 'toolRuns' = the args each echo execution received, in order.

messages.NUDGE: Your previous response contained no answer. Continue and give your answer.
messages.CONTINUE: Your previous response was cut off at the output token limit. Continue exactly where it stopped, without repeating anything.
messages.CORRECTIVE: Your previous tool call could not be used: its arguments were not a valid JSON object. Call the tool again with arguments that are a single valid JSON object matching its input schema.
